up: Retrieve the IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against human Aurora kinase A. For each matching activity, return: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, target_pref_name, target_organism, and standard_value. Filter for activities where standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. The target must be 'Aurora kinase A' with organism 'Homo sapiens'. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is available from the source document. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, a.standard_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.pref_name = 'Aurora kinase A' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
